summary: 36 features and 8 fixes across HagiCode-org/hagicode-core, HagiCode-org/web.
bodyHtml:
Features

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • process-tree: attribute CLI processes to owning sessions (88442fc)
  • session-process-tree: add live process trees and safe termination (661f53e)
  • session-file-diff: read files from nested repositories (c21b2f8)
  • agent-cli-interaction: enable questions by executor (1e2d6bd)
  • signalr: enrich session and quota updates (2729635)
  • session-file-diff: expose read-only session file diffs (2ca2bf0)
  • remote-voice-input: include hero identity in receiver snapshots (d7f890e)
  • session-changed-files: publish recent edits over SignalR and gRPC (33e0cd0)
  • cli-version: warm registered CLI versions after host startup (6035566)
  • hagitask-scope: unify repository, vault, and project scope (a09ed8e)
  • preset-task-scope: provide runtime scope selectors (7d6e43c)

HagiCode-org/web

  • process-tree: use generated gRPC for session process controls (e639b47)
  • process-tree: add interactive session process controls (2db4154)
  • process-tree: subscribe to live session tree snapshots (b6da8dd)
  • token-monitor: refine quota reset and exhaustion artwork (8922de1)
  • session-diff: remember long-line wrapping preference (32fd445)
  • search-input: standardize icon-aware fields across web (6194187)
  • web-density: lower the roomy tier breakpoint to 128rem (364d202)
  • token-monitor: show quota reset and exhaustion cards (4fadafe)
  • project-activity: show running counts on project cards (3640039)
  • conversation-queue: animate queued messages as an ordered rail (774a2a3)
  • session-diff: add a standalone session file diff viewer (8561117)
  • web-density: apply compact density across the web shell (593e2ac)
  • web-density: add a roomy tier for large desktop windows (d25e706)
  • mobile-steer: animate the hold-to-steer interaction (162e426)
  • remote-input: show the task Hero on the receiver (2241614)
  • task-creation: align project scope and remote context (094bc5e)
  • relative-time: support compact narrow labels (3760320)
  • preset-task: refine drawer scrolling and hero selection (b443ffe)
  • recent-setups: scope history and expose older selections (ed38465)
  • session-changed-files: add file change navigation to conversations (ba57dc9)
  • scenario-favorites: refresh inherited rosters from Fallback (db9a232)
  • preset-task: restore shared recent setup selections (ad7f76e)
  • url-appearance: apply per-page theme and language overrides (ba471a8)
  • hagitask-scope: send session scope as a structured request (60c4908)
  • preset-task-scope: align scope controls with proposal flow (a6265a2)

Fixes

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • token-monitor: normalize Magpie five-hour quota windows (64115cc)
  • task-scope: accept all repositories listed by project selector (7bb2a13)
  • token-monitor: move the initial usage read off host startup (6e1caa0)

HagiCode-org/web

  • web: normalise backslashes, not plus signs, in path reference history keys (4c281f5)
  • git: call repository rebase with the current contract (4f1efc3)
  • sheet: keep the close action within the header layout (eb3a020)
  • saga-group: wait for drawer to open before picking a session (ce6259c)
  • drawer: preserve nested overlays on Escape (0e7becc)
